items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: And by J Lo I don’t mean Joe Lovano.

ctx.x: Right. This is an ASCAP thing?

No, no. Jeez I think it’s called secondary markets fund or something. But you get, like if you’ve done a hundred record sessions in a year you’ll get a check that reflects that. And then if the song gets put in a movie or on a T.V. show or in a video game, which is common now, it’s been registered and in theory you’ll get some extra payment for that, as opposed to getting your five dollars for doing a record and then good-bye. So I’ve always been strongly in favor of the union because it protects us and it allows…
No, I knew you did not.
